tools.name: search_address
tools.description: Search Danish addresses by free text (street, number, floor/door, postcode). Returns address ids to pass to get_valuation. Example query: "Kilevej 6, 1. mf, 2000".

tools.name: get_valuation
tools.description: Statistical market-value estimate for one Danish home: value, likely range, confidence, how it was calculated, the comparable sales it rests on, earlier registered sales and the yearly property tax a new owner would pay. Takes an address_id from search_address. A cold lookup can take up to a minute.

tools.name: get_postcode_sales
tools.description: Registered home sales in a Danish postcode over the past year, per property type: count, median price, median price per m² and the most recent sales with links to their own valuations.

tools.name: get_assessment_check
tools.description: Compares the official 2026 property assessment (ejendomsvurdering), which sets the property tax from 2027, with the statistical market estimate for the same home, against the statutory 20 % rule that lets an owner ask for a reassessment. Returns the assessment, the estimate at the assessment date, t

tools.name: get_assessment_gap
tools.description: How often the indexed 2026 property assessment is more than 20 % above or below what homes actually sold for, for one Danish municipality beside the country, or (with no municipality) for the country with the ten highest and lowest municipalities. Built from public registers only.

tools.name: get_home_history
tools.description: What the building register (BBR) records about one Danish home: solar panels, ground-source heat loops, oil tanks, and dated changes of heating and roof material. Takes an address_id from search_address. A missing record is not evidence that nothing was done.
